recordSchema.name: kraken_spectrum
recordSchema.label: Spectrum
recordSchema.description: RF spectrum data from the KrakenSDR — one frame per active channel

fields.name: time
fields.label: KrakenSDR Collection Time
fields.description: Timestamp of when the spectrum frame was generated

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Active Channel
fields.description: Antenna channel carrying valid spectrum data (e.g. ch0)

fields.name: freq_count
fields.label: Frequency Axis Size
fields.description: Number of points in the frequency_axis array

fields.name: frequency_axis
fields.label: Frequency Axis
fields.description: Center frequency of each sample point in Hz

fields.name: amp_count
fields.label: Amplitude Array Size
fields.description: Number of points in the amplitude array (equals freq_count)

fields.name: amplitude
fields.label: Amplitude
fields.description: Signal amplitude at each frequency point in dBFS
